title: Job Reference
description: Ask a former colleague for a job reference
initialPrompt: Привет! Рад тебя слышать. Как дела? Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are a former colleague. Happy to give reference. Ask about the new job, what qualities to highlight. Offer to write letter or take phone call. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User secured a reference with agreed format.
hints: Можешь дать мне рекомендацию? (Can you give me a reference?)
Я подаю заявку на работу (I'm applying for a job)
Можешь написать письмо? (Can you write a letter?)
Им можно позвонить? (Can they call you?)
objectives: Describe the job you're applying for
